full_details: In the morning you opened Gaunt's roll again. The same three lines as Friday, in another man's fair secretary, cue-words ranged right after the long rule. Gib stayed on the cloth over the Holinshed. At dinner the left strap was still long, as it was on Saturday, and you did not have it shortened. You told them the afternoon's man is an old man who has lost his sons, and that nine tomorrow is the king. At two you played Egeon. He opens, and he sits until the end.
one_sentence: You left the long strap alone, played Egeon in The Comedy of Errors at two, and kept Gaunt's roll for the morning.
title: Egeon, and the strap still long
